newsitem.title: ESTONIA: BOURSE CLOSE - MIXED, TALSE FIRMS SLIGHTLY.
newsitem.headline: BOURSE CLOSE - MIXED, TALSE FIRMS SLIGHTLY.

text.p: * Preliminary data from the Estonian bourse on Friday put
total trade at 58.7 million kroons versus 68 million kroons.
* The Talse online index gained 0.38 percent to close at
267.73 (See index on stock exchange web site:
* Preliminary closing data put Hansapank as the
most active stock on trade of 15 million kroons to be 0.80
kroons higher for a last deal price of 142.00 kroons
